home.introBody: For over a decade we've crafted personalised journeys across India — from the Himalayas to Kerala, Rajasthan to the Northeast. Whether it's a week of temples and palaces, a mountain honeymoon, or an all-India grand tour, every trip is hand-built by travel designers who actually know these roads, stays and seasons.
home.stepsBody: From first hello to homecoming, four easy steps — and no upfront pricing pressure.
home.whyBody: We pair deep local knowledge across three states with concierge-level care, so every mile feels effortless and every moment feels yours.
home.testimonialsBody: Real words from travellers who let us carry their dreams across South India.
home.galleryBody: A glimpse into the places and light our travellers came home changed by.

about.storyTitle: A South India travel studio built on
about.storyBody:
Prithvi Holidays began with a simple belief: the best journeys aren't booked, they're designed. For over a decade we've paired deep local knowledge of South India with concierge-level attention to craft trips that feel made-to-measure — because they are.

From your first daydream to your final sunset, a dedicated travel designer walks every step with you.
